market_view: Calm tape (VIX 15.5, down 15% in 20 days) with falling yields and a softer dollar; oil dipped on cautious optimism over Iran, while gold miners and copper names are at highs after huge runs.

oil_gas.catalyst: none live: 'Oil prices dip as cautious optimism over Iran trumps new fears of Russian escalation in Ukraine' (NBC News) removes the Iran-risk premium behind the XOM long
oil_gas.reasoning: The 10-day hold has run (12 trading days since 2026-08-10) and WTI fell 3.1% on Iran deal optimism, undercutting the thesis. Exit XOM and stay flat.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: Gold three-month high (The Guardian) is an already-large move
gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is up 48% in 20 days at a 52-week high, gold up 16%; the move is priced. Headlines are opinion pieces and cost worries.

chips.catalyst: none usable: 'NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027' (NVIDIA Newsroom) is title only, no numbers or guidance visible
chips.reasoning: Nvidia results are a scheduled event but I cannot see the outcome, so there is no one-sided setup. Variance is high; no named, checkable edge.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific headline; the only pharma item is an unrelated FDA listeria notice. MRK's surge is not our name.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: copper at a high and FCX up 20% in 5 days is an already-large move; 'Cameco Owns the Refinery at the Center of Canada's Uranium Threat' (Motley Fool) is vague and about CCJ, not FCX
copper_uranium.reasoning: No FCX-specific named catalyst. The Freeport and cookware headlines are irrelevant noise. A price run alone is not a reason.

would_change_my_mind: A confirmed FCX supply shock or a named, unpriced catalyst for one of the leaders, or a visible Nvidia guidance surprise not yet reflected in the price.

handoff.what_changed: Oil fell (WTI 82.36, -3.1% in a day) on cautious optimism over Iran and the 10-day XOM hold ended, so XOM is exited. Gold, miners and copper names ran further; no named catalyst for any family.

oil_gas.why: XOM hold ended and Iran deal optimism removed the catalyst.

gold_miners.why: NEM up 48% in 20 days at a high is priced; no catalyst.

chips.why: Nvidia Q2 results headline has no visible numbers; no one-sided setup.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX-specific catalyst; FCX up 20% in 5 days is priced.
